task.title: Resetting a Service Desk Agent's Password
task.shortdesc: Use this procedure to reset a service desk agent's password when the agent is locked out or has forgotten their credentials.

prereq.p: You must have Administrator or Tier 2 Support access to the identity management console.

context.p: Agent password resets are self-service in most cases through the identity provider portal. Use this manual procedure only when the agent cannot access the self-service reset flow, such as when their recovery email is also unavailable.

step.cmd: Log in to the identity management console using your administrator credentials.
Search for the agent by employee ID or username.
Select Reset Password from the account actions menu.

info.p: This generates a temporary password and immediately invalidates the agent's current session.

step.cmd: Verify the agent's identity through an approved secondary method (manager confirmation or badge check) before delivering the temporary password.
Provide the temporary password to the agent through a secure channel, not email or chat.
Confirm the agent is prompted to set a new password on next login.

result.p: The agent can log in with the temporary password and is required to set a permanent password before accessing any system.
